newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Konka says to make offer statement soon.
newsitem.headline: China's Konka says to make offer statement soon.

text.p: Shenzhen Konka Electronic Group Co Ltd said on Sunday it would soon issue an explanation of its planned B share rights offer of three rights shares for every 10 shares held.
The company said in a statement published in the Financial Daily that its rights offer plan had been approved by regulatory authorities in Beijing and in Shenzhen.

The offer would be based on share capital of 118.2 million shares as of June 30, offering a total of 35.46 million new shares. It said 28.84 million shares would be offered to founding shareholders and another 6.62 million to the general public.
It said the rights shares would trade as warrants on the Shenzhen exchange, where the company has listed B shares for foreign investors and A shares for domestic investors.
It did not give a price for the rights shares or any further information.

Konka had said in January that it would offer rights on its B shares at a price between HK$2.80 and HK$5.90 each and the offer would have been made by early April. It gave no explanation for the delay.
Its B shares closed at HK$6.95 on Friday while its A shares ended at 16.10 yuan, up 1.20 yuan. ($1 = HK$7.8) ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
